description_en: Call the CreateCaster operation to create a production studio
kebab_example: aliyun live create-caster --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 53200b81-b761-4c10-842a-a0726d970000 --norm-type 1 --charge-type PostPaid --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCaster

parameters.help_en: The name of the production studio
parameters.name: caster_name

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a token on your client and ensure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。

该参数值可自定义，但是要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The type of the production studio. Valid values:

<props="china">

1: Standard.

3: Lightweight Carousel.

4: Virtual Studio.

6: Carousel (New Playlist).

</props>

<props="intl">

1: Standard.

6: Carousel (New Playlist).

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
导播台规格类型。取值：

<props="china">

1：通用型。

3：轻量级轮播型。

4：虚拟演播厅型。

6：轮播台（新播单型导播台）。

</props>

<props="intl">

1：通用型。

6：轮播台（新播单型导播台）。

</props>
parameters.name: norm_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Only PostPaid is supported. Valid values:

PrePaid: subscription (not supported).

PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
付费方式。 目前只支持PostPaid。取值：

PrePaid：预付费（暂不支持）。
PostPaid：后付费
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The purchase time of the production studio. The time is in the \`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ\` format and is displayed in UTC.

This parameter is available only if you set ChargeType to PrePaid
parameters.help_zh:
导播台购买时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。

当ChargeType为PrePaid时，此参数才可设置
parameters.name: purchase_time

parameters.help_en:
The expiration time of the production studio. The time is in the \`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ\` format and is displayed in UTC.

This parameter is available only if you set ChargeType to PrePaid
parameters.help_zh:
导播台过期时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。

当ChargeType为PrePaid时，此参数才可设置
parameters.name: expire_time

parameters.help_en:
The preset resolution of the production studio. This parameter is available only for the subscription billing method. Valid values:

lp_ld: low definition.

lp_sd: standard definition.

lp_hd: high definition.

lp_ud: ultra-high definition.

lp_ld_v: vertical low definition.

lp_sd_v: vertical standard definition.

lp_hd_v: vertical high definition.

lp_ud_v: vertical ultra-high definition.

If you use the pay-as-you-go billing method, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/60271.html operation to set the resolution
parameters.help_zh:
导播台预设分辨率。采用预付费方式时，取值：

lp_ld：流畅。
lp_sd：标清。
lp_hd：高清。
lp_ud：超清。
lp_ld_v：竖屏流畅。
lp_sd_v：竖屏标清。
lp_hd_v：竖屏高清。
lp_ud_v：竖屏超清。

后付费场景下，需要设置分辨率，请调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/60271.html接口进行操作
parameters.name: caster_template

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2381067.html
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID。关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2381067.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

CasterId.description_en: The ID of the production studio. You can use this ID as a request parameter to query stream URLs, start the production studio, add video resources, add layouts, query the layout list, add components, and add playlists
CasterId.description_zh: 导播台ID。可作为查询导播台流地址、启动导播台、添加导播台视频资源、添加导播台布局、查询导播台布局列表、添加导播台组件和添加导播台节目单的请求参数
